questions: Do you have any shortness of breath or does the chest pain get worse when you take a deep breath?
Have you had any recent leg swelling or pain (especially in one calf), or any recent long travel/immobility or surgery?
Do you have a fever, cough, or any blood when you cough (hemoptysis)?
What is your current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) and heart rate (or do you know if you’ve been told you’re hypoxic or tachycardic)?
When did the symptoms start, and are you able to identify any trigger or worsening (e.g., while lying down vs moving around)?
Do you know your current respiratory rate (how many breaths per minute) or have you been told you’re breathing very fast?
“Have you taken your temperature and do you have an oxygen saturation reading (SpO₂) from a pulse oximeter?”
Have you taken your blood pressure, temperature, and oxygen saturation (SpO₂) with a pulse oximeter since the symptoms started?
Have you noticed any one-sided decrease in breath sounds or wheezing on that side, or has anyone said your breathing sounds are abnormal?
